task: Bounded independent read-only audit of Name refresh, explicit Unplayed, and known-pool guards

source_pin.method: git archive of the assigned immutable commit; extracted into reviewer-owned reports, not a checkout or worktree change

summary.interpretation: A passed observation group can assert that an existing bug STILL reproduces. Six completed groups do not mean all existing findings are fixed.

verified_improvements.result: Changed nonempty Name clears only wire 0x6d bit0 in the supported 12.13.10.3/756-byte record. All 256 raw byte values were tested; upper bits, 0xee, rank/cache word 0x290 and unrelated track nodes remained unchanged. Serialized/reparsed Name matched. Same-value and empty-name controls do not clear the bit; the older supported version does not receive the new correction.
verified_improvements.limit: This certifies deterministic bit preservation, not native acceptance of every upper-bit pattern or empty/missing Name fallback.

verified_improvements.result: The explicit Boolean getter/setter uses inverse bit0 at 0xee, independently of Name, rating and play_count. Both requested values were tested for all 256 raw byte values, with serialization/reparse and peer preservation. Eleven non-Boolean inputs refuse atomically; 24 field-order permutations and a late failing operation-list transaction preserve the intended success/rollback boundary.
verified_improvements.limit: No simulated playback, COM setter side effects, implicit date updates, or PlayedCount-to-Unplayed inference is certified.

verified_improvements.result: Fifteen independent alias controls across track Name, genre, comment, composer, sort fields, miah301/302 and miih400/401 refuse without changing bytes or current node identities. Same integer in separate pools remains allowed. Unkeyed insertion into a populated explicit pool, conflicting existing bindings during text change, and a conflicting same-lineage restore refuse atomically.
verified_improvements.limit: These are known-domain refusal guards, not a scoped allocator or general COW implementation. Raw reads can still preserve an already conflicting pool; that is not semantic resolution.

known_remaining_findings.title: Negative fractional pre-epoch values still truncate to the unset sentinel
known_remaining_findings.result: 1903-12-31T23:59:59 plus 1, 500000 or 999999 microseconds encodes as raw0 rather than refusing the out-of-range value. The prior integer HFS fix is not a fix for this fractional-boundary defect.
known_remaining_findings.recommendation: Validate signed timedelta bounds before quantization and avoid float truncation across the lower bound, keeping the established wall-time policy.

safety_and_limits: Writes only in reports/review; original phase1/phase2 reports, reproductions and worktree are unchanged.
No production modifications, checkout, branch/commit/push, native iTunes/COM/UI/Frida actions, environment lifecycle, package installation, secret inspection or child sessions.
One bounded lightweight Python process at a time, bytecode disabled and UTF8 explicit. Confirmed peaks are below512MiB.

Initial pytest resource instrumentation omitted the 64-bit HANDLE prototype and produced an invalid zero measurement. Its run was collected and evidence preserved; the same pinned test suite was rerun successfully with explicit pointer types. Zero was never treated as a real memory measurement.
The added script's six groups reuse pinned synthetic builders and the production parser for construction/reads. They are independent assertions, not a second independent binary-format implementation.
Known pools and profile-specific refusal are narrower than native global allocation/callback semantics. Some otherwise feasible joint edits are intentionally refused.
The three phase2 native-harness observations are scoped to that report's pinned source. Working phase3 harness improvement claims are not retrospectively substituted for it.
No newer main/codec commit is silently included. Pending fixes must be checked against their own immutable commit before being marked resolved.
